entries.say.variants.default: Back fence still has a loose plank, and the rain barrels need checking. How are we looking on chores?
entries.reply.agreed.say.variants.default: Good. Grab a hammer and some nails—we'll get it buttoned up before dark.
entries.reply.deferred.say.variants.default: Fair enough. Let's leave the heavy hammering until morning so we don't draw anything.
entries.reply.checked_in.say.variants.default: It's holding for now, just needs another pair of hands when we get a quiet hour.
entries.reply.refused.say.variants.default: Not the time for chores. Keep your eyes on the yard.
